Hi Sergio / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intake yesterday. For the upcoming SIG/CIS baseline review we need a small, exportable set of onboarding/offboarding and personnel artifacts — enough to demonstrate controls without sharing PII. Can you deliver the following by Friday 2028-06-07?

- Redacted background-check summary (single PDF with redaction markers)
- Q2 training roster export showing completion dates and employee IDs (CSV)
- Onboarding/offboarding runbook (DOCX or PDF) + list of last 6 deprovisioning events (log sample)
- Chain-of-custody for hired contractor accounts (high level, no credentials)

We prefer one bundle (zipped) and a short index doc that maps filenames to control IDs (SIG/CAIQ references). HubSpot ticket: HSP-84921.

If you have an internal contact for redaction or a secure transfer link (Drive or SFTP), please include it. If sample size is a concern, a cohort of ~12 recent hires is fine.

Thanks,
Jane

Audits Co.

- redacted-bg-checks-summary.pdf (Kimberly will assemble and apply name/SSN redaction markers) — K.Park owner
- training-roster-2028-q2.csv (Rishi will export completion records; will include employee IDs only, no email addresses) — R.Malhotra owner
- onboard-offboard-runbook-v2.docx (Operational runbook with playbook steps + retention pointers) — Sergio owner
- deprovision-log-sample.txt (anonymized log entries for 6 events) — Sergio to extract
- chain-of-custody-mapping.xlsx (high-level mapping to SIG control IDs) — Grace to draft

Two quick clarifications:
1) You said "cohort of ~12" — will 12 be sufficient for your sampling? We can expand to 25 if you prefer.
2) Redaction: we will mark PII fields and include a redaction manifest (what fields removed). Is that acceptable?

We plan to upload a single ZIP to a restricted Drive folder and share an access link with two-week expiration. Expected delivery: 2028-05-31 EOD Pacific for the initial bundle, with Grace's control mapping to follow on 2028-06-03. If that timing looks tight for your review cycle, say so and we can prioritize BG + roster first.

Planned attachments (will send in follow-up): training-roster-2028-q2.csv, redacted-bg-checks-summary.pdf, onboard-offboard-runbook-v2.docx

Best,
